entry.external_evidence: Not yet in durable storage. Renders and boards were made in the build session and can be regenerated from tools/catalogue_concert_hall_pilot.
limitations: Fixed native assembly, 100.0 m by 76.4 m including the 6 m paved apron; the podium is 88 m by 64.4 m. No resizing and no repetition.
Gate A is open: the variant's street view (variant_2.png) is the grey preview of the old LEGO model. The model follows the oblique and roof views; a person must accept that or supply a street view.
The oblique and roof views place the oculus about 8 m apart; the roof view governs plan positions. Heights take the catalogue's two 5 m floors because the oblique barely constrains them.
The north and east ground floor, the interiors, the roof-garden entrance and the hall size (about 340 stalls seats, only as large as the oculus) are inferred.
The foyer floor is 0.13 m above the apron at every glazed door; no ramp or flush threshold is drawn.
Terrain fit, entrance routing and every runtime gate are untested; see tools/catalogue_concert_hall_pilot/integration/runtime-review.md.

Independent review: v007 was refused with four P1 (evidence/independent-review-v007.json). v009 passed on 2026-11-22 with zero P0, zero P1 and three P2 (evidence/independent-review-v009.json). Open P2: five fins over the service door stand 8 to 18 cm off the cladding; the lobby stair behind the roof portal ends at a closed wall; two minor coplanar faces at the stair well and a north mullion.

picker.description: Concert hall under two bronze spiral shells round a glazed oculus, on a finned podium with a roof garden.
picker.reshape_description: Move and rotate the complete building. It keeps its authored size.
